title: Amazon: Artex-Driven AI Agents Stole API Keys to Fund Model Calls
summary: Amazon says attackers used the open-source penetration-testing framework Artex to drive AI agents that harvested API keys from internet-exposed AI applications, including LiteLLM and Dify, validated the keys, and pooled them to pay for additional large-model calls. The campaign began on October 3 and was disrupted on November 5 by Amazon&\#x27;s MadPot decoy network, according to the company. Amazon attributed the activity to a China-linked threat group with medium confidence, said not all listed targets were actually compromised, and stated it has notified potentially affected AWS customers. The account is a vendor claim with limited independent technical detail released so far.
